current_example.worked_solution:
We can write the given problem as the following product:

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14146952/assets/102e3ccf0daf49575be896f437eebfd2e40e0148775c6cf6cf4e6877966b941d.svg)

Using the relationship between multiplication and division, we can write our problem as follows:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14146952/assets/66a2e828dadcf027f8a0d28c5bbebf4e159ff44279dbd89ff9c38e02235f1471.svg)

To write this fraction as a percentage, we write an equivalent fraction with $100$ as the denominator:

$$
\dfrac{35}{20} = \dfrac{35 \times 5}{20 \times 5} = \dfrac{175}{100}
$$

Now we can write this fraction as a percentage:

$$
\dfrac{175}{100} = 175 \%
$$
